sources.title: The Python Language Reference
sources.notes: Normative. When the tutorial and the reference disagree about semantics, the reference wins.

sources.title: The Python Standard Library
sources.notes: Behaviour of built-in types, functools, collections, heapq and the exception hierarchy.

sources.title: The Python Tutorial
sources.notes: First-party but pedagogical rather than normative; cite the reference for exact semantics.

sources.title: Python Programming FAQ
sources.notes: The canonical first-party explanations of aliasing and of mutable default arguments.

sources.title: Python HOWTOs
sources.notes: Functional programming HOWTO covers iterators, generators and generator expressions.

sources.title: Python Glossary
sources.notes: Used to keep term blocks aligned with the language's own vocabulary.

sources.title: PEP 8 - Style Guide for Python Code
sources.notes: Cited for naming, comparison style (`is None`) and truth-value testing conventions.

sources.title: PEP 20 - The Zen of Python
sources.notes: Only cited where a concrete design rule follows from it. Not a substitute for the reference.

sources.title: PEP 202 - List Comprehensions
sources.notes: Historical rationale; comprehension scoping changed after this PEP, so pair it with the reference.

sources.title: PEP 234 - Iterators
sources.notes: Defines the iterator protocol and the StopIteration contract.

sources.title: PEP 289 - Generator Expressions
sources.notes: The memory argument for generator expressions over list comprehensions.

sources.title: PEP 318 - Decorators for Functions and Methods
sources.notes: Where decorator syntax and its desugaring are specified.

sources.title: PEP 3134 - Exception Chaining and Embedded Tracebacks
sources.notes: `raise X from Y`, __cause__ and __context__: the basis of the error-contract concept.

sources.title: CPython source tree
sources.notes: Cited only for implementation details that the language reference deliberately leaves open, such as small-int caching.

sources.title: TimeComplexity - Python Wiki
sources.notes: Community-maintained, so priority sits below the reference deliberately; every figure taken from it is cross-checked against CPython behaviour.
